assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent scrolling parallax atlas for the cartoon horror runner Noite da Horda. Input image is ONLY a palette, brushwork and layered-layout reference. Create a NEW 1536x1024 RGBA PNG with true transparent empty sky. Exactly THREE landscape strips stacked in separate equal-height rows, each spanning the full width; leave clear transparent gutters between them. No sky backdrop, no moon, no characters, no text, no signs with writing, no UI. Top strip is distant skyline, middle strip medium-distance buildings and streets, bottom strip near scenery. Left and right edges of each row should join naturally for horizontal tiling. Keep all content within its band, no objects touching neighbouring bands. Soft painted volume, chunky plum outlines, twilight lavender, teal shadows and amber highlights matching the reference, cinematic but playful cartoon, original game art. Buildings have attractive varied architecture and readable silhouettes, no generic boxes. Theme: a beautiful city in PANIC during a monster invasion at night. Top row lavender distant skyline of towers, church spires and radio antennas with a little reddish smoke. Middle row rich Victorian and art-deco street frontages, shops with awnings, damaged windows, crooked streetlights and a tram bridge, warm orange lights and small painted fires. Bottom row near street rubble, fire hydrants, road barriers, broken lampposts, scattered papers, teal pavement edges. Do not paint people or helicopters; these will be animated independently. Transparent space above each silhouette, enough gaps between near props to see through. Rich readable architecture, restrained flames.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated animation rig parts, not a finished posed character. Input image is only a style/layout reference. New square 1536x1536 transparent PNG, exactly THREE columns and THREE rows, nine equal cells. Large transparent gutters and padding, no touching or cropped parts, no text or grid. Cartoon chibi painted art with bold plum outlines and soft shading matching reference. Character faces RIGHT in three-quarter profile. Layout in reading order: HEAD including short neck, TORSO ending at hips without limbs, UPPER ARM shoulder to elbow, FOREARM elbow to wrist, HAND, THIGH hip to knee, SHIN knee to ankle, FOOT pointing right, ACCESSORY. Limb segments are STRAIGHT VERTICAL, proximal joint at top, rounded overlapping ends; not whole bent arms or legs. Only one separate part in each cell. Subject: a living HUMAN CIVILIAN fleeing in panic, fair peach skin, shaggy golden-brown hair, large expressive brown eyes and open frightened mouth; blue hoodie torso over coral shirt, blue sleeves, peach forearm and hand, dark jeans thigh and shin, ivory sneaker with coral accent. Human facial features, no green skin and no wounds. ACCESSORY is a detached small orange backpack. Keep cute proportions similar to the game's zombie.
